name: The Urban Nest Athens - Suites & Apartments
description: The URBAN NEST Suites & Apartments are set in a six-storey building, once a shoe-making workshop and now converted into the highest quality rooms and apartments, set in the urban maze of central Athens. URBAN NEST is located in the centre of Psyri, a hipster neighbourhood only a few meters away from Monastiraki Square, the Acropolis, Syntagma Square and Plaka. This makes it an ideal starting point for exploring the historic city centre. At the same time, the URBAN NEST is strategically located in the most multicultural and developing district of the city, Psyri, a lively neighbourhood full of street cafes, eateries and local handicraft businesses, that allows you to get to know at first hand the real cultural pulse of the city.
